summary_1line: Bhishma recounts a legend explaining the divine origin of royal chastisement (punitive authority) and its necessity for maintaining order and righteousness.

image_candidates.scene_text: On a Himalayan peak beneath a great banyan tree, the ascetic king Vasuhoma receives Mandhatri with ritual water and offerings.
Brahma sneezes after holding a divine fetus in his head for a thousand years, and the being Kshupa falls forth into the world.
Rishis and kings gather on the sacred height of Munjaprishtha in the Himalayas, a holy retreat associated with Rudra.
